pages.title: Shake it
text: A dried gourd on a bone handle, and a piece of [Spiritgear](spiritgear). **Hold use** and shake: every half second it mends whoever you are looking at within 6 blocks, or you, when you are looking at no one.
Each shake heals **3/4 of a heart** and spends **2 Pulse**, from the rattle's own cell first and then from the cells you carry. It works on players, villagers and familiars alike.

pages.title: Ranks and voices
text: It ranks at the Echo stations like the rest of Spiritgear, and every rank heals **50%** more. From **Bound** it also eases [Spirit Sickness](spirit_sickness) by a level every shake.
Link it to a totem for a gift on every shake:
- **Water**: heals half again as much.  - **Spirit**: lifts every harmful effect.
